Screen reader users will navigate each checkbox in isolation without programmatic context that they belong to a single logical group. This violates the WAI-ARIA APG Checkbox Group pattern and WCAG 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships). The design requires structural remediation before shipping. **Pre-commitment Predictions**: Before reading the code, I predicted: 1. Missing `
